sentences.text: aggrieved, the petitioner approached this Court as he apprehends to his arrest.
This Court vide order dated 04.11.2024 issued notice and granted interim protection to the petitioner subject to his cooperation with the ongoing investigation.
Heard learned senior counsel/counsel for the petitioner and the respondent-State.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that there is no need of custodial interrogation of the petitioner, we are of the opinion that the prayer of the petitioner should be allowed and the order dated 04.11.2024 made absolute.
Accordingly, in the event of the arrest of the petitioner, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail forthwith on the usual terms and conditions to be decided by the concerned Court.
The present petitions shall stand disposed of in the above terms along with pending application(s), if any.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
